SELECT a.*, hsno.read_flag as read_flag, hsno.done_flag as done_flag, su.description as source_user_name FROM hls_system_notice a LEFT JOIN hls_system_notice_owner hsno ON hsno.owner_allocation_id = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and hsno.notice_id=a.NOTICE_ID ,sys_user su
a.SOURCE_USER_ID = su.USER_ID and (( a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 1 AND a.SOURCE_ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) OR (a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 3) OR (a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 2 AND a.SOURCE_ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT})) AND (hsno.read_flag='N' or hsno.read_flag is null or hsno.read_flag='')
and a.NOTICE_TYPE =#{dto.noticeType}
and a.NOTICE_ID =#{dto.noticeId}
and a.NOTICE_MESSAGE like concat(concat('%',#{dto.noticeMessage}),'%')
and 1 = (case when #{dto.readFlag}='Y' and hsno.read_flag='Y' then 1 when #{dto.readFlag}='N' and (hsno.read_flag='N' or hsno.read_flag is null or hsno.read_flag='') then 1 else 0 end)
order by a.notice_datetime desc

SELECT a.*, hsno.read_flag as read_flag, hsno.done_flag as done_flag, su.description as source_user_name FROM hls_system_notice a LEFT JOIN hls_system_notice_owner hsno ON hsno.owner_allocation_id = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and hsno.notice_id=a.NOTICE_ID ,sys_user su
a.SOURCE_USER_ID = su.USER_ID and a.notice_type='TODO' and (hsno.done_flag is null or hsno.done_flag != 'Y') and a.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID in ( select distinct t1.ID_ from act_ru_task t1 ) and (( a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 1 AND a.SOURCE_ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) OR (a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 3) OR (a.NOTICE_LEVEL = 2 AND a.SOURCE_ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocation_id,jdbcType=BIGINT}))
and a.NOTICE_ID =#{dto.noticeId}

SELECT * FROM hls_system_notice hsn LEFT JOIN hls_system_notice_owner hsno ON hsno.notice_id = hsn.NOTICE_ID WHERE hsn.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID = #{source_document_id} AND hsn.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='WFL.TO_DO' AND (hsno.done_flag is null or hsno.done_flag != 'Y')

SELECT hls.NOTICE_ID as noticeId, hls.NOTICE_MESSAGE as message, hls.NOTICE_DATETIME as dateTime, hls.SOURCE_MODULE as documentType, hls.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID as documentId, hls.SOURCE_EVENT as eventCode, hls.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY as category, #{contractId} contractId FROM hls_system_notice hls WHERE hls.NOTICE_TYPE='NOTICE' AND hls.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='CONTRACT_SIGN' AND hls.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID in ( SELECT ccs.contract_sign_id FROM con_contract_sign ccs WHERE ccs.contract_id = #{contractId} ) order by hls.NOTICE_DATETIME asc
